newsitem.title: USA: CME June S&P 500 futures rise 7-pt opening limit.
newsitem.headline: CME June S&P 500 futures rise 7-pt opening limit.

text.p: June Standard & Poor's (S&P) 500 futures rose the 7.00-point opening price limit Tuesday.
The contract rose to 754.30, up 7.00 points, during the first 10 minutes of pit trading, which began at 0830 CDT/1330 GMT.
If futures were limit-bid at 0840 CDT/1340 GMT, trading would halt for two minutes.
After the opening limit expires, there are no subsequent daily limits restricting price rises; the only limits are to price declines. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
